sides.note: In the fish. Jonah: wa-yman YHWH dāḡ gāḏôl liḇlōaʿ ʾeṯ-yônâ ... šəlōšâ yāmîm û-šəlōšâ lêlôṯ, then a full psalm (qārāʾṯî mi-ṣṣārâ lî ... mi-bbeṭen šəʾôl šiwwaʿtî). Q: fa-ltaqamahu l-ḥūtu wa-huwa mulīm, fa-law-lā annahu kāna mina l-musabbiḥīna la-labitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yubʿathūn. The fish swallows him while blameworthy (mulīm). There is no three-day count, and the psalm is reduced to his being one who glorifies. The counterfactual of staying in the belly until the Resurrection has no Hebrew counterpart.
